label: TRUE_UNDOCUMENTED
justification: `fill` pushes an unbounded Purchase entry per call into storage (line 126) and `_closeOffer` linearly iterates that array performing an ERC1155 _mint per entry, so once the array is large enough the closing `fill` always runs out of gas, leaving isOpen true forever - the NFT is unrecoverable (redeem reverts with StillOpen) and buyers' payments are stuck. It is cheap to mount here: totalShards is 1e25 in the deployed offer and a 1-shard fill costs zero payment tokens because of the mulDivDown rounding, so an attacker only pays gas to bloat the array. Distinct from the documented rounding bug.
